view.scene_description: A low-angle shot inside a large warehouse with high shelves stocked with boxes and red crates. Workers in red and black uniforms move through aisles. Signs indicate sections like 'FLEISCH 2' and 'FLEISCH 3'. The floor is concrete, and lighting comes from overhead fixtures. Motion blur suggests active movement.

objects.label: person walking
objects.observation: A person in motion, wearing dark pants and a red-and-black jacket, blurred due to movement. Their right foot is forward, left foot trailing. They walk across the foreground, partially obscuring background shelves. No visible tools or cargo.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Stacked red plastic crates on a grey pallet in the mid-ground. Some are stacked vertically, others horizontally. Crates have white labels. Located near a worker and under a shelf labeled 'FLEISCH 2'.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: High metal shelving units with yellow safety rails, filled with cardboard boxes. Labels like 'FLEISCH 3' and 'FLEISCH 2' are visible. Units extend into the background, creating depth. Some shelves are empty.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Stacked brown cardboard boxes on grey pallets, arranged in rows. Boxes have white labels. Located on the left side of the frame, behind the walking person. Some boxes are stacked higher than others.

objects.label: overhead lights
objects.observation: Bright fluorescent lights mounted on the ceiling, providing illumination. Lights are evenly spaced along the ceiling. Reflect off the polished concrete floor and metal surfaces.

objects.label: worker in background
objects.observation: A second worker in red and black uniform, standing near red crates and shelving. Partially obscured by the main subject. Appears to be handling or organizing items. Not in motion.
